# War Scroll Column 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 4 | **Condition:** complete

---

**4:1** upon the fifth: "Thousands-of God"; upon the sixth: "Hundreds-of God"; upon the seventh: "Fifties-of God";

**4:2** upon the eighth: "Tens-of God." And on each standard they-shall-write the full order-of its names. And when they advance to-battle they-shall-write on the first

**4:3** standard: "Wrath-of God"; on the second: "Anger-of God"; on the third: "Splendor-of God"; on the fourth: "Vengeance-of God";

**4:4** on the fifth: "Praise-of God"; on the sixth: "Exaltation-of God"; on the seventh: "Wonder-of God."

**4:5** And when they return from-battle they-shall-write upon the first standard: "Deliverance-of God"; upon the second: "Victory-of God"; upon the third: "Help-of God";

**4:6** upon the fourth: "Support-of God"; upon the fifth: "Joy-of God"; upon the sixth: "Thanksgivings-to God"; upon the seventh: "Peace-of God."

**4:7** [...] the standards [...] shall-be four[teen cub]its long. And on the standard-of the [...] they-shall-write: [...]

**4:8** [...] And on the shield-of the Prince-of the whole congregation they-shall-write his name, and the name "Israel," and "Levi," and "Aaron," and the names

**4:9** of the twelve tribes-of Israel according-to their generations, and the names-of the twelve chiefs-of their tribes.

**4:10** The rule-of arranging the battle-divisions for-war, when their army is-complete: a front-battle-line [...] men-of the line, and lines of

**4:11** ga[p betwee]n the battle-lines [...] And they-shall-arrange the battle-line-of the slingers, seven lines, and the masters-of the sling-stones

**4:12** to-hurl [...] And-beside-them the-archers shall-arrange a line on-the-right and on-the-left. And they-shall-arrange

**4:13** seven lines-of shield-bearers, and the length-of-the-shield seven cubits, the width four cubits, and the dagger-of war upon-it. And they

**4:14** [shall be ar]ranged in lines, one-hundred shields to-a-line. And around-each line the shield-bearers shall surround-them on-their-two-sides,

**4:15** three-hundred shields. And the shields-of the tower: two, and the tower shall-go-out [...] thus shall three towers come-forth from-behind the lines

**4:16** and the men-of the tower [...] and they-shall-arrange three lines-of the men-of battle behind the [...] the first tower. And two-lines

**4:17** shall go-forth [...] and thus they-shall-take-up-position, battle-line and tower. And they-shall-select [...] of foot-soldiers.

---

*EMET notes: Column 4 continues the standard inscriptions (completing the series begun in Col. 3), then describes shield inscriptions for the Prince of the whole congregation and the twelve tribes. Lines 10-17 shift to tactical formations: slingers, archers, shield-bearers, and tower formations. Shield dimensions specified: 7 cubits by 4 cubits. Tower formations involve three mobile units advancing from behind the main battle lines.*
